decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and using cards like Goryo's Vengeance to bring them back onto the battlefield for a game-winning combo. With a mix of control elements like Force of Negation and Solitude, as well as efficient card draw and reanimation spells, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent while setting up the combo, leading to explosive turns and quick victories.

This deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing a variety of multicolored creatures and powerful spells to overwhelm the opponent quickly. The key strategy is to establish early board presence with efficient creatures like Wild Nacatl and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while using Tribal Flames and Lightning Bolt to deal direct damage and control the board. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding provide additional support by boosting creature power and locking down opponent's threats. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a companion, adding extra versatility to the deck's mana base.

This Mono Black Aggro deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand and board while applying constant pressure with efficient creatures and Liliana of the Veil. The deck includes hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek, along with removal spells like Fatal Push. The deck also utilizes cards like The Rack and Dauthi Voidwalker to chip away at the opponent's life total. Urza's Saga provides additional threats, while Mishra's Factory can turn into a creature to further pressure the opponent. Castle Locthwain helps with card advantage and ensuring a steady stream of threats.

The main idea behind this deck is to maintain control of the board while putting early pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler. By utilizing efficient removal spells like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt, along with counter spells like Counterspell, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and close out the game quickly. The inclusion of cards like Murktide Regent and Expressive Iteration allow for card advantage and flexibility in different situations, making it a versatile and powerful aggro deck in the Modern format.

The main concept of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption, removal spells, and powerful threats. Utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, Liliana of the Veil, and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, the deck aims to control the board and grind out value over time. The One Ring provides a win condition while cards like Grief and Dauthi Voidwalker help to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also utilizes land destruction with Field of Ruin and Demolition Field to disrupt the opponent's mana base.

The main concept of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's resources while leveraging powerful control spells such as Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Liliana of the Veil. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by utilizing cards like Grief, Dauthi Voidwalker, and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to dominate the board and maintain control. The deck also utilizes land destruction with cards like Field of Ruin and Demolition Field to disrupt the opponent's mana base. Ultimately, the goal is to grind the opponent out of resources and win through attrition.

This deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures such as Griselbrand using Goryo's Vengeance and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. It also has disruption in the form of cards like Thoughtseize and Faithful Mending to protect the combo. The deck seeks to quickly fill up the graveyard with cards like Grief and Tainted Indulgence to set up the reanimation combo. Solitude provides removal for threats, while Ephemerate can be used to protect key creatures or reuse their abilities. The deck is designed to efficiently bring back creatures and control the board to win the game.

This deck focuses on quickly and aggressively running through the opponent's defenses with efficient spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. It also utilizes the graveyard with cards like Underworld Breach and Mishra's Bauble to gain advantage and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to control the game with counterspells while deploying threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Thoughtbound Phantasm to quickly close out the game. The inclusion of cards like An Offer You Can't Refuse and Enhanced Surveillance adds versatility and disruption to the deck's game plan.

The key concept of this deck is to assemble the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Power Plant, and Mine) to generate large amounts of mana early in the game. This allows the deck to play powerful threats like Wurmcoil Engine and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger, while also utilizing control elements like Karn, the Great Creator and Oblivion Stone to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes card selection tools like Ancient Stirrings and Sylvan Scrying to help find the key pieces needed to execute its game plan effectively.

This deck focuses on utilizing Cascade cards to overwhelm the opponent with quick and efficient plays, while also controlling the board with counterspells and removal spells. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Ardent Plea to cascade into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Leyline of the Guildpact, the deck aims to create a fast and aggressive game plan that can quickly close out games before the opponent can establish their own strategy. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and Subtlety adds additional control elements to disrupt the opponent's plans.

This Rakdos aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive play, utilizing efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes powerful threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to quickly close out the game. Not Dead After All helps to recur key creatures while Blood Moon disrupts greedy mana bases. The deck aims to apply early pressure, disrupt the opponent's strategy, and maintain a strong board presence to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

The main concept of this deck revolves around assembling the Urza lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate a large amount of mana to play powerful threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The deck also includes powerful board wipes like All Is Dust and Oblivion Stone to control the opponent's board while ramping into game-winning threats. The inclusion of cards like Expedition Map and Sylvan Scrying help to consistently find the Urza lands to ensure the deck's strategy is executed smoothly.

The deck focuses on using cards that cycle through the graveyard to eventually play Living End, a card that returns all creatures from the graveyard to the battlefield. The deck includes creatures with abilities that trigger when cycled or discarded, as well as counter spells to help protect the combo. The goal is to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures, then cast Living End to bring them all back at once. The deck also includes lands that provide additional support or mana fixing for the combo.

This deck focuses on utilizing a toolbox of creature cards to create powerful combos and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By using cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Delighted Halfling, it can generate value and control the board. The deck also includes cards like Chord of Calling and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician to search for specific creatures as needed. The key strategy is to use the creatures in combination with each other to create advantageous board states and win conditions.

The deck focuses on utilizing a variety of creatures with different abilities to create combos and control the board. By using cards that allow for tutoring and sacrificing creatures, the deck aims to create a toolbox of creatures to adapt to different situations and win conditions. The inclusion of cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician showcase the deck's ability to generate value through sacrificing and manipulating creatures. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent by leveraging its diverse creature toolbox.

This aggro deck focuses on utilizing Leyline cards to gain an advantage over the opponent, while also using a mix of creatures and spells to maintain pressure. It includes versatile cards like Counterspell and Lightning Bolt for control and removal, as well as creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Scion of Draco to quickly deal damage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of threats and disruption, using Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding to protect its own board presence.
